data.change_summary: Closed the remaining carbonate follow-ups by making `TankSnapshot::from_state` use the freshly solved carbonate equilibrium for both `ph` and `co2_aq_mmol_per_l`, documenting `SourceWaterProfile::bicarbonate_mg_per_l` as display-only rather than an authoritative chemistry input, converting the schema 3→4 save migration to a deliberate serde-default no-op so missing `animal.reserve_g` stays at zero, and reworking shrimp feeding so periphyton and detritus share one routing-mass appetite cap. I updated regression coverage to lock in the default-zero reserve migration and added a unit test proving snapshot pH/CO2 come from one consistent carbonate solve; the shrimp intake regression now asserts the corrected routing-mass ceiling instead of the old mixed-unit expectation.
outstanding_risks: `solve_carbonate_equilibrium()` still uses the freshwater-focused approximation with fixed `Ka2`, so any extension beyond the intended pH 5.5-8.5 aquarium envelope should revisit the chemistry model.
Legacy saves with custom out-of-range source-water catalog entries still deserialize, but runtime water-change actions against those profiles fail validation until the profile is corrected.
The unrelated untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory remains in the worktree and was left untouched.

steps.description: Inspect the current snapshot, source-water, save-migration, and shrimp-feeding paths to confirm which pending amendments were still live in the workspace.

Patch the remaining gaps by making snapshot carbonate outputs self-consistent, documenting non-authoritative source-water bicarbonate, preserving missing `reserve_g` at serde default during v3→v4 migration, and moving shrimp detritus fallback accounting onto the routing organic-matter basis.
Update regression coverage and run formatting, full tests, and clippy across the affected crates to verify the amended carbonate/save/shrimp behavior.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core -p tank_data -p tank_scenarios` passed, including `types::snapshot::tests::snapshot_uses_one_carbonate_solution_for_ph_and_co2` and `systems::shrimp::tests::shrimp_feeding_caps_total_intake_on_routing_mass_basis` in the `tank_core` unit-test set.
`cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_data -p tank_scenarios --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

`git status --short` after validation showed only the intended tracked edits in `crates/tank_core/src/save.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/snapshot.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/source_water.rs`, `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs`, plus the pre-existing unrelated untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory.
